descriptionAdvanced.en: Viña del Mar, known as the "Garden City," is Chile's most popular coastal resort, located directly adjacent to Valparaíso. It is famous for its well-manicured parks, clean beaches, and elegant Belle Époque villas, such as the Wulff Castle perched on the rocks. Every year, the city hosts the world-renowned Viña del Mar International Song Festival, one of the most important musical events in Latin America. With its luxury casinos, top-tier restaurants, and vibrant nightlife, it remains a favorite destination for both domestic and international tourists, with the flower clock serving as its most photographed landmark.

en: Founded in 1874 by the Vergara family on their former country estate.
Hosts the International Song Festival at the Quinta Vergara Amphitheater since 1960.
The Municipal Casino of Viña del Mar is one of the oldest and most prestigious in South America.
The Flower Clock (Reloj de Flores) was installed in 1962 for the FIFA World Cup.
Known for its distinctive architecture, including the gothic-style Wulff Castle perched on the rocks.
